caption: The drawing depicts a round, hollow vessel with a small, straight neck at the top and a circular opening in the center, resembling a ring. The vessel is rendered in grayish tones with blue decorative elements, including four blue heart shapes evenly spaced around the circular body and a blue floral motif at the bottom center of the base. The letters "M.S." are inscribed near the neck at the upper part of the vessel. The object sits centered on a plain, beige background, with subtle shading and shadow giving it a three-dimensional appearance.
title: Ring Bottle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
